sn36.5:1.3: Sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukā vedanā || ||
sn36.5:1.4: Sukhā bhikkhave vedanā dukkhato daṭṭhabbā || dukkhā vedanā sallato daṭṭhabbā || adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato daṭṭhabbā || || 4
sn36.5:1.5: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sukhā vedanā dukkhato diṭṭhā honti || dukkhā vedanā sallato diṭṭhā hoti || adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato diṭṭha hoti ||
sn36.5:1.6: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu sammaddaso acchejji taṇham vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ sammamānābhisamayā antam akāsi dukkhassā ti || ||
